'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Step 3
* '''Username:''' TacoBill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
